items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: that night in Pete Lala's camera

ctx.x: that's the first time I remember seeing Jelly Roll, that night in Pete Lala's camera. Old Faith Mavis. That's the first time I'd seen Faith before I heard it. Steve, I knew it. I knew it. Just who he was.
You know. You were playing already, so...
